crossRefs.note: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
When Yahweh saw that they humbled themselves, Yahweh’s word came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves. I…
Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to…
After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat…
Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the…
There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and…
“Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there…
and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because…
For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

translations.web: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
translations.bsb: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.
translations.kjv: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
translations.asv: God hath made himself known in her palaces for a refuge.
